subject: Request: Keep PoC open — integration drift causing demo delay (Ekara)
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@ekara.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference> , Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Lauren Mills <lauren.mills@ekara.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PoC integration blocker — asking to keep sandbox active and request credits

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Quick note from our engineering team: we ran into an unexpected auth drift when trying to push the payment connector to staging. The integration team estimates ~10 business days to unblock (identity provider update + retry logic), which pushes our demo past the PoC end date.

Given the delay, can Redwood keep our sandbox/PoC active and provide a small top-up of credits so our engineers can finish the integration and run a final end-to-end demo? We don't want to lose momentum — product is still a green light on our side.

I've attached the integration log that shows the auth errors and timestamps.

Requested: 2-3 week PoC extension + temporary credit top-up (we're flexible on the amount; ideally something to run 2 full end-to-end test cycles).

Thanks,
Samir Shah
Platform Lead, Ekara Inc.
samir@ekara.com
Attachment: integration-log.txt (text)
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Shah <samir@ekara.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PoC integration blocker — asking to keep sandbox active and request credits

Thanks for the heads up, Samir — sorry to hear about the auth drift. Appreciate the log; that helps.

We can definitely keep the PoC sandbox active while your team works through the fix. Before I loop in approvals, a couple quick asks so we can fast-track the top-up:
- Can you confirm the expected cutover date (when you expect retries to be complete)?
- How many full E2E runs do you anticipate (ballpark tokens/requests) so we can size the credit top-up?
- If there are any dates you cannot make for the demo, please list them so we can propose new slots.

Tentative internal suggestion: offer a 2-week extension + 20k token sandbox credit while the team finishes the fix. I'll loop Karthik for engineering risk tolerance and Marissa for credit approval. If procurement needs a formal note, tell me the contact and I can send it to them.

Priyom
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
pri_yom@redwood.inference
From: Samir Shah <samir@ekara.com>
To: Priyom Das <pri_yom@redwood.inference>
Cc: Lauren Mills <lauren.mills@ekara.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 08:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PoC integration blocker — asking to keep sandbox active and request credits

Appreciate the quick reply, Priyom.

Timeline: our engineers expect the auth provider update to be scheduled Friday (8/6) and then 5 business days of validation — so realistically the earliest complete date is 8/13, latest 8/18.

E2E runs: to be safe, plan for ~3 full runs (each run uses approx 6k tokens in our harness), so ~18k tokens total. If you can front 25k tokens we should be covered.

Procurement contact: procurement@ekara.com — they may need a one-line note confirming credits and the new PoC end date for internal tracking.

I've attached a short stack trace snippet that shows the retry failures. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Samir
Attachment: stacktrace_snippet.txt (text)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Priyom Das <pri_yom@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PoC integration blocker — asking to keep sandbox active and request credits

Priyom / team — reviewed the logs Samir sent. Looks like a token expiry + IdP config drift; fix is non-trivial but bounded. From an engineering and cost perspective:

- I support keeping the sandbox active. No notable replay or safety concern.
- 25k token credit covers their ask with cushion for a final smoke test.
- Given the uncertain finish date (8/13–8/18), I'd recommend a 3-week extension to avoid repeated approvals if there's any follow-up work.

Ben — can you approve a one-time 25k token credit and extend PoC by 3 weeks for Ekara (deal RDW-2319-EK)? I'll take point on notes for the engineering checklist and provide an integration-checkpoint call after the IdP cutover.

On Thu, Aug 5, 2027 at 08:29, Samir Shah <samir@ekara.com> wrote:
> Timeline: our engineers expect the auth provider update to be scheduled Friday (8/6) and then 5 business days of validation — so realistically the earliest complete date is 8/13, latest 8/18.
>
> E2E runs: to be safe, plan for ~3 full runs (each run uses approx 6k tokens in our harness), so ~18k tokens total. If you can front 25k tokens we should be covered.

--
Karthik Iyer
Principal Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
To: Priyom Das <pri_yom@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@ekara.com>, procurement@ekara.com
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PoC integration blocker — asking to keep sandbox active and request credits

Thanks for the context, Karthik and team. Approved.

Redwood will:
- Add a one-time sandbox credit of 25,000 tokens to Ekara's PoC environment (deal RDW-2319-EK).
- Extend the PoC end date by 3 weeks from the original expiry. Please confirm the new proposed demo window after your validation completes.
- We'll send a short confirmation note to procurement@ekara.com for their records.

Conditions: this is a one-time top-up for integration validation only; credits are non-transferable and expire with the extended PoC window. If the integration requires additional engineering work outside the scope described, we'll revisit.

Samir / Lauren — can you confirm the new demo date range once you have validation complete (8/13–8/18 is the working window)? We'll block a canary demo slot once confirmed.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.inference
